workLog.task: Correct the frozen 2026-07-07 snapshot in ai-agents-change-control
workLog.outcome: The skill taught 9 allowlist patterns, named .agents/memory/episodes/ among them, and cited ADR-034 lines 79-83 to argue the code had drifted wider than the ADR. All three statements were true when written and all three were invalidated by one commit: 96e9bf7d2 (2026-07-08, PR #2958) dropped .agents/memory/episodes/ as redundant under .agents/memory/, taking the module from 9 to 8, and the ADR Amendment landed the same day. Measured with the real accessor across history: a333cb70c 9, 59e6587c4 9, 96e9bf7d2 8. The line-range citation is the instructive part: 79-83 was the whole list then and is a truncated window now, because lines 84-86 were appended. A range citation silently becomes a truncation when the cited block grows, and a truncation reads like evidence of drift. Prose copy replaced with the accessor call.

workLog.task: Harden the parity test against widening
workLog.outcome: A mutation matrix against the real document showed containment accepted a widened allowlist: adding src/ to the protocol clause passed every test. Fixed by scoping exact set equality to the enumeration span and parsing it without a prefix filter, so a forbidden path breaks equality while contrast prose outside the span stays legal. Suite grew 19 to 35 tests. Post-fix matrix: 4 widening and narrowing mutations fail, 4 formatting mutations pass.
python3 build/scripts/build_all.py exit 0; all five canonical and mirror pairs verified byte-identical with diff -q per file rather than trusting the build summary, which undercounts rewrites.

workLog.task: Correct my own first reading of the change-control defect
workLog.outcome: The first pass called the three statements fabrications and the episodes pattern a phantom, on a grep of the current module alone. Checking the module's history showed the pattern was real until 2026-07-08. A grep of HEAD answers what is true now, never whether a claim was true when written; for a staleness verdict the history is the negative control. The debate log, the provenance citation, and this log were corrected in a follow-up commit rather than by rewriting the pushed ones.
